summary: RedCloud Holdings plc furnished a Form 6-K on October 15, 2026, attaching a press release announcing its first commercial customer in Saudi Arabia. Khamis Arabia Trading Co., a Riyadh- and Dammam-focused FMCG wholesaler, will adopt the RedAI infrastructure under an initial 24-month agreement beginning June 2026 and supplied a dataset covering $21 million of trades across more than 540,000 SKU-level transactions. The contract sits with subsidiary RedCloud Technologies Limited and will be novated into the previously announced Saudi Arabia and Bahrain joint venture once formed. No price per share, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. This is an ordinary commercial-win disclosure, not a special situation; watch only for JV formation and data-monetization progress.
